public.how.title: Tso nukuɖeŋkeke va afɔɖeɖe
public.how.lead: Zi geɖe la, wotsɔa asi ŋlɔa afɔɖeɖe la ɖi, eye eyae nye yeyetɔ abe yeyewɔwɔ mamlɛtɔ ene. Le afisia la, míetsɔ yame ƒe nɔnɔme si woŋlɔ ɖi la ɖoa afɔɖeɖe, eye tɔtrɔ ɖe sia ɖe dzraa eƒe kpeɖodzi ɖo.
public.step.1.title: Ŋlɔ nu si agbledela nya ɖi
public.step.1.body: Wodzraa agblewo, agble akpawo, nukuwo kple nukuɖeŋkekewo ɖo le Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Xɔ yame ƒe nɔnɔme si va yi
public.step.2.body: Woxɔa ŋkeke sia ŋkeke ƒe dzoxɔxɔ na agble la ƒe teƒe tso Open-Meteo ƒe xoxoŋlɔɖi, tso nukuɖeŋkeke va egbe.
public.step.3.title: Bu dzoxɔxɔ ƒe ŋkeke
public.step.3.body: Wobua dzoxɔxɔ ƒe ŋkeke (GDD) ɖe nuku la ƒe model dzi. Ne xexlẽme la va dzidzenu la, ɖoɖola tsɔa nukuɖeɣi la yia afɔɖeɖe si kplɔe ɖo, eye wòŋlɔa eƒe gɔmeɖose ɖi.
public.models.title: Nuku ƒe model siwo míele zãm
public.models.lead: Dzoxɔxɔ ƒe ŋkeke si hiã be nuku la nabɔ blibo. Míeŋlɔ dzidzenu siawo kple asi, eye míexɔ nya tso ŋlɔɖi aɖeke me haɖe o.
public.live.title: Nɔnɔme le Swartland kpɔɖeŋu-agble la
public.live.lead: Xexlẽmewo tso dutoƒo ƒe nyatakaka me; wòle yeyem miniti 30 ɖe sia ɖe.
public.yields.title: Nuku ƒe xexlẽme siwo wota ɖe go
public.honesty.title: Ale si míewɔa ɖe nyatakaka ŋu
public.honesty.1.title: Dɔdzikpɔlae ŋlɔa nuku ƒe xexlẽme ɖe eme
public.honesty.1.body: Va se ɖe esime dɔwɔla aŋlɔ nu si woŋe la ɖi, app la afia “Womeŋlɔe ɖi o”.
public.honesty.2.title: Nutata siwo wotsɔna sɔ la nye ŋkɔɖoɖo bubuwo
public.honesty.2.body: Wodzra nutata tso nutome kple dukɔ blibo la me ɖo ɖe wo ŋutɔ ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo me, eye wogblɔ afi si wotso kple dzidzenu. Wometsɔa wo sɔa kple agble aɖe ƒe nuŋeŋe o.
public.honesty.3.title: Nuŋlɔɖi tso agble-gblẽlawo ŋu nye nutome tɔ
public.honesty.3.body: Wofia GBIF nuŋlɔɖiwo abe afi si wokpɔ agble-gblẽlawo le 100 km me ene, eye wofia didimeawo hã.
public.honesty.4.title: Yame ƒe nɔnɔme le yiyim
public.honesty.4.body: Ne wobia la, woɖea dzoxɔxɔ ƒe nutata tso Open-Meteo ƒe xexlẽdzraɖoƒe me.
public.open.title: ʋu agbleɣeyiɣi aɖe
public.open.body: Ge ɖe kpɔɖeŋu ƒe dɔwɔƒe la me be nàkpɔ agbleɣeyiɣi aɖe ƒe GDD fli kple kpeɖodzi si fia eƒe afɔɖeɖe.

public.about.title: Eŋuti nya
public.about.heading: Mecropolis ŋuti nya
public.about.lead: Mecropolis nye agble kple nuku dzikpɔnu le Western Cape ƒe agble aɖe me.
public.about.why.title: Nu si tae wòle anyi
public.about.why.body: Agble ƒe afɔɖeɖe tsia megbe, eye woŋlɔa nuŋeŋe ɖi tso ŋkuɖoɖo me. Mecropolis tsɔ yame ƒe nɔnɔme si woŋlɔ ɖi la bua afɔɖeɖe. Xexlẽdzesi ɖe sia ɖe tso dɔwɔla alo dutoƒo si woyɔ ŋkɔ gbɔ.
public.about.design.title: Ale si wowɔe
public.about.design.1.body: Tso ŋkeke si wodzra nu la dzi la, dzoxɔxɔ ƒe ŋkeke (GDD) ƒoa ƒu tso Open-Meteo ƒe xexlẽdzraɖoƒe me. Ne afɔɖeɖe trɔ la, wodzraa eƒe kpeɖodzi ɖo: ŋkeke si wòdze egɔme, GDD blibo la kple nu si dzi wotu eɖo.
public.about.design.2.body: Woyɔ afɔɖeɖe si kplɔ ŋeŋe ŋgɔ la be dzoxɔxɔ me ɖoɖo, elabena womeŋlɔ nuŋeŋe aɖeke ɖi o.
public.about.design.4.lead: Nutata siwo wotsɔna sɔ la nye nyatakaka kpeɖeŋutɔ.
public.about.design.4.body: Wodzraa wo ɖo ɖe wo ŋutɔ ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo me, eye wogblɔ afi si wotso, dzidzenu kple mɔɖeɖe.
public.about.stack.title: Dɔwɔnuwo
public.about.stack.body: Vite kple React 19 ƒe axa ɖeka app le Cloudflare Pages dzi. Browser la xlẽa Sanity ƒe dutoƒo si le gaglã la tẽe to GROQ kple nyatakaka-yeyewɔla dzi. Nuŋlɔɖi kple nyatakaka si bia asixɔxɔ dzesii la toa Cloudflare Pages Functions dzi, eye wòkpɔa session cookie si woŋlɔ asi ɖe ŋu la ɖa. Zod kpɔa nyatakaka ɖa le mɔwo nu, Vitest wɔa dodokpɔ, eye Tailwind 4 wɔa dzidzenu.
public.about.limits.title: Nya siwo míenya be wole gbɔdzɔe
public.about.limits.1: Nuku ƒe akpa siwo model la zãna (dzoxɔxɔ gɔmedzedze, dzoxɔxɔ ƒe ɣeyiɣi va se ɖe dzedze kple ɖoɖo me) nye ame ŋutɔe ŋlɔ wo, eye dutoƒo mele wo ŋu haɖe o.
public.about.limits.2: Lupin ƒe nutata si wotsɔna sɔ la tso HarvestStat le ƒe 2000 va 2007 ko me, eye gɔmedzedze ƒe dɔ la mekpɔ lupin ƒe nutata-nuŋlɔɖi aɖeke o.
public.about.limits.3: Agble-gblẽlawo ƒe nyatakaka nye GBIF nuŋlɔɖi siwo le agble la gbɔ. Wofia afi si woŋlɔ lã alo ati ƒomevi aɖe ɖi le agble la gbɔ.
public.about.limits.4: Kpɔɖeŋu la me, ame sia ame zãa geɖeɖe ɖeka, eye woxea geɖeɖe geɖe dzi le ŋku me ko. Geɖeɖe la ɣlaa dɔwɔƒe ƒe axawo, gake mexea nyatakaka la dzi o: ame sia ame ate ŋu axlẽe. Ke boŋ exea nuŋlɔɖi ɖe sia ɖe dzi.

docs.stages.title: Afɔɖeɖe ƒe ɖoɖo
docs.stages.intro: Agbleɣeyiɣiwo yina ŋgɔ to afɔɖeɖe ade me:
docs.stages.guards: Afɔɖeɖe ɖe sia ɖe me yiɖeŋgɔ le se aɖe te. Nu si wodzra bia dzadzraŋkeke kple nuku; nu si le tsitsim bia dzedze ƒe dzoxɔxɔ-ŋkeke ƒe liƒo; ŋeŋe ŋgɔ bia ɖoɖo ƒe liƒo ƒe 90%; dzoxɔxɔ me ɖoɖo bia be woato ɖoɖo ƒe liƒo la; ŋudzɔdzɔ bia agbleɣeyiɣi ƒe yame-nɔnɔme ƒe nɔnɔmetata kple nutata si wotsɔna sɔ si woɖo kpe edzi. GDD ƒe sewo hã bia dzoxɔxɔ ƒe nyatakaka le ɣeyiɣi la ƒe 90% ya teti, eye woxea afɔɖeɖe si ƒe gɔmedzedzeŋkeke le etsɔme la dzi.

docs.seed.body: {0} ŋlɔa kpɔɖeŋu agble, agblewo, nukuwo kple nuŋeɣiwo ɖe nyatakakaƒe si nèɖo la me, eye wòwɔa nuto la ƒe dzidzedze sɔsɔwo yeye. Etrɔa agble, agblewo kple nukuwo katã, eya ta wɔe ɖe nyatakakaƒe si nye tɔwò ko ŋu.
guide.title: Ale si nàzã Mecropolis
guide.lead: Mɔfiame kpui aɖe le gbe bɔbɔe me. Egblɔ nu si ta wowɔ app la, ame siwoe wòle na, kple ale si akpa ɖesiaɖe wɔa dɔe.
guide.what.title: Nu si Mecropolis nye
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis nye agble kple nukuwo dzikpɔla. Ebu nuku ɖesiaɖe ƒe tsitsi ƒe afisi wòle to dzoxɔxɔ si wòkpɔ tso nuƒãɣi me ƒoƒo nu. Eɖea gbedoxɔxɔ, anyigba kple lã vɔ̃ɖi siwo le wò agble gbɔ fia le teƒe ɖeka.
guide.what.p2: Wowɔe na agblewo le Western Cape le South Africa, gake mɔ sia wɔa dɔ le agble, nuto kple nuŋeɣi ɖesiaɖe me.
guide.who.title: Ame siwoe wòle na
guide.who.p1: Ele na ame si kpɔa agblewo dzi, abe agblela, agble dzikpɔla alo aɖaŋuɖola si kpena ɖe wo ŋu ene.
guide.who.p2: Mehiã be nànya nu tso kɔmpiuta alo yame ƒe nɔnɔme ŋu o. Ne àte ŋu ʋu website la, ekema àte ŋu azã Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Nu si ta nàzãe
guide.why.1: Àte ŋu akpɔ enumake nuku siwo woƒã ko, esiwo le tsitsim kple esiwo te ɖe ŋeŋe ŋu.
guide.why.2: Mehiã be nàtrɔ asi le agble ɖesiaɖe ŋu o, elabena app la ŋutɔ yi nuku ɖesiaɖe ɖe ŋgɔ ne gbedoxɔxɔ la fia be ɣeyiɣi de.
guide.why.3: Eɖea gbeƒã na wò tso avuvɔ kple dzoxɔxɔ si gbɔna le ŋkeke ʋɛ aɖewo me, kple lã vɔ̃ɖi siwo wokpɔ le wò agble gbɔ ŋu.
guide.why.4: Nu siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe agble aɖe ŋu, abe atike tsitsi, lã vɔ̃ɖi si nèkpɔ alo nyagblɔɖi ene, nɔa teƒe ɖeka kple woƒe ŋkeke, ale be àte ŋu akpɔ wo emegbe.
guide.why.5: Xexlẽme ɖesiaɖe fiaa afi si wòtso, ale be nànya esi dzi nàte ŋu aka ɖo.
guide.heat.title: Ale si app la nya nuku ƒe tsitsi ƒe afisi wòle
guide.heat.p1: Nukuwo tsina kabakaba ne dzoxɔ, eye wotsina blewu ne vuvɔ. Mecropolis bua dzoxɔxɔ sia gbe sia gbe abe dzoxɔxɔ ƒe akɔntawo ene; nunyalawo yɔa wo be growing degree days alo GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Gbe sia gbe, ebua dzoxɔxɔ kɔkɔtɔ kple dzoxɔxɔ bɔbɔtɔ ƒe titina, eye wòɖea dzoxɔxɔ si me nuku la megatsina o la le eme. Esi susɔe nye gbe ma ƒe dzoxɔxɔ ƒe akɔnta. Gbe si vuvɔ la metsɔa naneke kpee o.
guide.heat.p3: Nuku ɖesiaɖe hiã dzoxɔxɔ ƒe akɔnta ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ aɖe hafi wòɖi. Ne agbɔsɔsɔ tso nuƒãɣi me te ɖe xexlẽme ma ŋu la, nuku la yi tsitsi ƒe akpa si kplɔe ɖo me.
guide.heat.p4: Dzoxɔxɔ ƒe xexlẽmewo tsoa Open-Meteo, yame ƒe nɔnɔme dɔwɔƒe femaxee si ŋlɔa yame ƒe nɔnɔme le xexeame ƒe teƒe ɖesiaɖe.
guide.stages.title: Tsitsi ƒe akpa adeawo
guide.stages.intro: Nuku ɖesiaɖe le agble ɖesiaɖe me toa akpa siawo me le ɖoɖo sia nu.
guide.stages.planning: Woɖo nuŋeɣi la, gake womede nuku la anyigba me haɖe o.
guide.stages.growing: Nuku la le dzoxɔxɔ ƒe akɔntawo ƒom nu.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Nuku la ƒo dzoxɔxɔ si wòhiã la ƒe akpa gãtɔ ƒu, eya ta ele be woaɖo ŋeŋe ŋu.
guide.stages.harvested: Nuku la ƒo dzoxɔxɔ si wòhiã la katã ƒu, eya ta ele be wòɖi. Wò koe ate ŋu agblɔ ne woŋee vavã, eya ta app la yɔa esia be dzoxɔxɔ me ɖiɖi.
guide.stages.review: Nuŋeɣi la wu enu, eye àte ŋu akpɔ ale si wòyi la.
guide.stages.p2: App la kpɔa nuku ɖesiaɖe me zã ɖesiaɖe, kple ɣe sia ɣi si ame aɖe tsɔ ŋukpɔkpɔ alo dɔwɔwɔ kpee. Àte ŋu azi Reconcile now le nuŋeɣi aɖe dzi be wòakpɔe enumake hã.
guide.start.title: Ale nàdze egɔme
guide.start.1: Ʋu aƒeme axa la. Àte ŋu akpɔ yame ƒe nɔnɔme ƒe anyigbatata, anyigba, lã vɔ̃ɖiwo kple nuku siwo woŋe le kpɔɖeŋu agble la me, evɔ mehiã be nàge ɖe eme o.
guide.start.2: Zi Sign in le tame, eye nàzã kpɔɖeŋu akɔnta ƒe nyatakaka siwo wona wò.
guide.start.3: Tia agble aɖe. Esia ʋua agble ma ƒe nyatakakawo ƒe axa.
guide.start.4: Zi nuŋeɣi aɖe dzi be nàkpɔ nu sia nu tso nuku ɖeka ma le agble ɖeka ma me ŋu.
guide.start.5: Zã gbe ƒe aɖaka si le axa ɖesiaɖe tame be nàtrɔ gbe la. App la ɖoa wò tiatia ŋku ne ègava emegbe.
guide.home.title: Aƒeme axa
guide.home.p1: Aƒeme axa la fiaa nuto la ƒe anyigbatata si ƒe amadede fia dzoxɔxɔ si anyigba la kpɔ le nuŋeɣi sia me. Egafiaa yame ƒe nɔnɔme fifia kple ŋkeke ʋɛ siwo gbɔna, kpɔɖeŋu agble la ƒe anyigba, lã vɔ̃ɖi siwo wokpɔ le gbɔ le ŋkeke siwo va yi me, kple nuto la ƒe nukuŋeŋe ƒe titina. Mehiã be nàge ɖe eme hafi akpɔe o.
guide.dashboard.title: Agble ƒe nyatakakawo ƒe axa
guide.dashboard.intro: Nyatakakawo ƒe axa la fiaa agble ɖeka. Esiawoe nye eƒe akpawo tso axa la tame yi ete. Agble ƒe aɖaka si le tame la na wòte ŋu yi agble bubu me.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Agble ƒe nya kpui
guide.dashboard.summary: Agblewo kple ha siwo le agble la me, nuŋeɣi siwo le edzi yim, kple nuku siwo ɖi la ƒe xexlẽme.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Ehiã ŋkuɖoɖo
guide.dashboard.alerts: Nuxlɔ̃ame kpuiwo, abe avuvɔ alo dzoxɔxɔ le gbedoxɔxɔ me, nuku si ɖi, nuŋeɣi si medze egɔme le ɣeyiɣi dzi o, alo lã vɔ̃ɖi siwo wokpɔ le agble aɖe gbɔ ene. Nuxlɔ̃ame ɖesiaɖe gblɔa nu si hee vɛ.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Agble ƒe nɔnɔme
guide.dashboard.conditions: Egbe ƒe yame ƒe nɔnɔme, gbedoxɔxɔ, anyigba kple lã vɔ̃ɖi siwo le agble sia gbɔ.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Nuŋeɣi ƒe yiyime
guide.dashboard.progress: Kpekpeɖeŋu aɖe le nuku ɖesiaɖe ŋu si fia dzoxɔxɔ si wòƒo ƒu. Àte ŋu atsɔ agblewo asɔ kple wo nɔewo, eye nàɖe xexlẽdzesi la abe spreadsheet ƒe faɛl (CSV) ene.
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Agblewo
guide.dashboard.fields: Agble ɖesiaɖe kple eƒe lolome, anyigba kple nukuwo.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Di nyatakakawo
guide.dashboard.search: Ŋlɔ nu si nèdi la le gbe bɔbɔe me, abe nukuŋɔ̃wo le bli la dzi ene. Edi ŋukpɔkpɔwo kple dɔwɔwɔ siwo ƒe gɔme sɔ, ne wozã nya bubuwo gɔ̃ hã.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Aɖaŋuɖoɖowo
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Dɔ siwo woɖo ɖa na agble aɖe, abe atike tsitsi alo agbleme nuɖuɖu ene. Àte ŋu alɔ̃ ɖe ɖesiaɖe dzi alo agbee, eye nàde dzesi be wowɔe vɔ ne dɔ la wu enu.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Nu siwo wowɔ fifia tɔ
guide.dashboard.activity: Ɣeyiɣi si nuku ɖesiaɖe yi tsitsi ƒe akpa yeye me ƒe xexlẽdzesi.
guide.season.title: Nuŋeɣi ƒe axa
guide.season.intro: Nuŋeɣi nye nuku ɖeka le agble ɖeka me le ƒe ɖeka me. Eƒe axa la le nu sia nu tso eŋu.
guide.season.top.label: Axa la tame
guide.season.top: Nuku la, agble la, nuƒãŋkeke, ŋeŋeŋkeke si wo le mɔ kpɔm, kple nuku si woŋe ne èŋlɔe ɖe eme.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Tsitsi ƒe akpawo
guide.season.pipeline: Tsitsi ƒe akpa adeawo, eye wode dzesi esi me wòle fifia. Zi Reconcile now be woakpɔ enumake ne ele be nuku la nayi ŋgɔ.
guide.season.readiness.label: Nɔnɔme na nyametsotso
guide.season.readiness: Nu siwo app la hiã hafi nate ŋu ana nuku la nayi ŋgɔ ƒe xexlẽdzesi, abe nuƒãŋkeke kple yame ƒe nɔnɔme ƒe nyatakaka si de ene. Nu ɖesiaɖe gblɔa Pass, Warning alo Blocked, eye esi wotu mɔ na la gblɔa nu si mekpɔ o.
guide.season.evidence.label: Kpeɖodzi
guide.season.evidence: Nyatakaka siwo app la zã le eƒe nyametsotso me, ale be àte ŋu akpɔ wo me.
guide.season.propose.label: Tsɔ aɖaŋuɖoɖo aɖe vɛ
guide.season.propose: Gblɔ dɔ si woawɔ le agble sia me, eye nàtsɔ nuŋeɣi la ƒe kpeɖodzi akpee. Anɔ abe nuŋlɔɖi gbãtɔ ene va se ɖe esime ame aɖe alɔ̃ ɖe edzi le nyatakakawo ƒe axa la dzi.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Dzesi si fia dzoxɔxɔ ƒe akɔntawo ƒe ƒoƒo nu tso nuƒãɣi me, kple fli si fia agbɔsɔsɔ si nuku la hiã.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Ke ne...?
guide.season.whatIf: Te nuƒãŋkeke si le ŋgɔ alo megbe, alo nuŋeɣi si xɔ dzo wu alo vuvɔ wu kpɔ, eye nàkpɔ ale si dzoxɔxɔ ƒe akɔntawo atrɔe. Womedzraa naneke ɖo o.
guide.season.summary.label: Nuŋeɣi ƒe nya kpui
guide.season.summary: Nuŋeɣi la ƒe nyatakakawo ƒe nya kpui si AI ŋlɔ. Xlẽe abe kpeɖeŋutɔ ene, eye nàkpɔ nyatakakawo me ne nu aɖe medze egɔme o.
guide.season.notes.label: Nuŋeɣi ƒe nyagblɔɖiwo
guide.season.notes: Nuŋeɣi la ƒe nyagblɔɖi siwo le ŋkeke dzi. Àte ŋu atsɔ wo akpe ɖe eŋu, atrɔ wo, atutu wo, eye nàgbugbɔ nyagblɔɖi ƒe nɔnɔme xoxo aɖe vɛ.
guide.season.files.label: Agble ƒe foto kple anyigba dodokpɔ ƒe agbalẽ
guide.season.files: Tsɔ agble la ƒe foto kple anyigba dodokpɔƒe ƒe PDF ɖe eme.
guide.season.log.label: Agble ƒe ŋkekegbalẽ
guide.season.log: Nu si nèkpɔ le agble la me (ŋukpɔkpɔwo) kple nu si nèwɔ le eŋu (dɔwɔwɔwo, abe atike tsitsi kple atike la ƒe ŋkɔ kple dzidzenu ene).
guide.season.history.label: Tɔtrɔwo ƒe ŋutinya
guide.season.history: Tɔtrɔ ɖesiaɖe si wodzra ɖo le nuŋeɣi sia me kple eƒe ŋkeke.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Nuto la ƒe dzidzedze sɔsɔ
guide.season.benchmark: Nuto la ƒe nukuŋeŋe ƒe titina tso dukɔme xexlẽmewo me. Ele afi ma na sɔsɔ, eye menye wò agble ƒe nukuŋeŋe o.
guide.season.pests.label: Nuto la me lã vɔ̃ɖi siwo wokpɔ
guide.season.pests: Lã vɔ̃ɖi siwo wogblɔ be wokpɔ le agble la gbɔ le GBIF, dukɔme ŋukpɔkpɔwo ƒe nyatakakaƒe. Zi Fetch sightings be nàxɔ esiwo yeye wu.
guide.sources.title: Afi si xexlẽmewo tsoa
guide.sources.weather: Yame ƒe nɔnɔme tsoa Open-Meteo, na egbe, gbedoxɔxɔ kple ŋkeke siwo va yi.
guide.sources.soil: Anyigba ƒe nyatakaka tsoa SoilGrids, xexeame ƒe anyigba ƒe anyigbatata.
guide.sources.pests: Lã vɔ̃ɖi siwo wokpɔ ƒe nyatakaka tsoa GBIF, dukɔme ŋukpɔkpɔwo ƒe nyatakakaƒe.
guide.sources.yields: Nuto la ƒe nukuŋeŋe tsoa USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa kple World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Nu bubuwo katã, abe nyagblɔɖiwo, dɔwɔwɔwo kple mia ŋutɔ miaƒe nukuŋeŋe ene, nye nu si wò alo wò dɔhawo ŋlɔ ɖe eme.
guide.limits.title: Nu si mate ŋu awɔ o
guide.limits.model: Dzoxɔxɔ ƒe akɔnta si nuku ɖesiaɖe hiã la nye mía ŋutɔ míaƒe akɔntabubu, eye míedoe kpɔ le agble me o. Zãe abe mɔfiame ene, eye nàka ɖe nu si nèkpɔ le wò agble me dzi.
guide.limits.maturity: Xɔxɔme dzodzo nu la, nuku la ele be yeŋu. Ke wò koe nya ne exɔ ŋutɔ.
guide.limits.translation: AI ye ŋlɔ gɔmeɖeɖeawo. Ele be woanɔ bɔbɔe, gake Eʋegbe gblɔla menɔ ŋku ɖe wo katã ŋu o.
guide.limits.demo: Ame sia ame ate ŋu azã kpɔɖeŋu sia, eya ta mègblɔ nu ɣaɣla aɖeke le eme o.
